@startuml Stage_2_Class_Diagram ' Stage 2 = Stage 1 + VIPCustomer / CriticCustomer (and calculateBillCents). ' All Stage 1 relationships are retained unchanged (same types, labels, multiplicities). title Restaurant Rush - Stage 2 Class Diagram skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0 left to right direction skinparam linetype ortho skinparam shadowing false skinparam roundcorner 6 skinparam nodesep 170 skinparam ranksep 120 skinparam defaultFontSize 20 skinparam Padding 8 skinparam ArrowFontSize 17 skinparam titleFontSize 36 skinparam ArrowThickness 1 skinparam groupInheritance 1 skinparam class { BackgroundColor #ECECEC HeaderBackgroundColor #ECECEC BorderColor #555555 ArrowColor #222222 BackgroundColor<> #DCEBFA HeaderBackgroundColor<> #DCEBFA BorderColor<> #1F5FA8 BackgroundColor<> #FDE5C8 HeaderBackgroundColor<> #FDE5C8 BorderColor<> #B35C00 BackgroundColor<> #DDF2DD HeaderBackgroundColor<> #DDF2DD BorderColor<> #2E7D32 BackgroundColor<> #EADCF5 HeaderBackgroundColor<> #EADCF5 BorderColor<> #6A2C9A BackgroundColor<> #D3F0EE HeaderBackgroundColor<> #D3F0EE BorderColor<> #00796B BackgroundColor<> #ECECEC HeaderBackgroundColor<> #ECECEC BorderColor<> #555555 } skinparam legend { BackgroundColor #FFFFFF BorderColor #333333 } hide empty members hide circle ' ============================================================================ ' CLASSES ' ============================================================================ class Main { + {static} main(args: String[]): void } class ConsoleUI <> { - scanner: Scanner {final} - out: PrintStream {final} -- + {static} formatMoney(cents: int): String + displayStartOfTurn(turn: int,\n restaurant: Restaurant): void + promptMenuChoice(promptTitle: String,\n options: List): int + displayArrival(customer: Customer, turn: int): void + displayWaiterAction(description: String): void + displayOrderTaken(order: Order): void + displayChefAction(description: String): void + displayOrderCooked(order: Order): void + displayPaymentCollected(order: Order): void + displayEatingFinished(customer: Customer,\n table: Table): void + displayAbandonment(customer: Customer): void + displayTurnSummary(turn: int,\n restaurant: Restaurant): void + displayFinalResult(result: GameResult): void } class GameController <> { - restaurant: Restaurant {final} - ui: ConsoleUI {final} -- + runGame(): void + evaluateGameResult(): GameResult + runTurn(turn: int): void - executeStep1Arrivals(turn: int): void - executeStep2And3StaffActions(turn: int): void + buildLegalWaiterActions(): List - getLowestNumberedFreeTable(): Table - executeWaiterAction(action: WaiterAction,\n turn: int): void + buildLegalChefActions(): List - executeChefAction(action: ChefAction): void - executeStep4EatingAndPayment(turn: int): void - executeStep5WaitingAndAbandonment(): void - executeStep6EndSummary(turn: int): void } enum WaiterActionType <> { WAIT SEAT_CUSTOMER TAKE_ORDER SERVE_ORDER } class WaiterAction { - type: WaiterActionType {final} - description: String {final} - customer: Customer [0..1] {final} - table: Table [0..1] {final} - order: Order [0..1] {final} -- + {static} createWait(): WaiterAction + {static} createSeat(customer: Customer,\n table: Table): WaiterAction + {static} createTakeOrder(customer: Customer,\n table: Table): WaiterAction + {static} createServeOrder(order: Order): WaiterAction } class ChefAction { - wait: boolean {final} - description: String {final} - order: Order [0..1] {final} -- + {static} createWait(): ChefAction + {static} createCook(order: Order): ChefAction } abstract class Staff <> { - name: String {final} - actedThisTurn: boolean -- + resetTurnState(): void # markActed(): void } class Waiter <> { + seatCustomer(customer: Customer, table: Table,\n queue: WaitingQueue): void + takeOrder(orderId: int, customer: Customer,\n table: Table, menu: Menu, random: Random): Order + serveOrder(order: Order, turn: int): void + waitTurn(): void } class Chef <> { + prepareOrder(order: Order): void + waitTurn(): void } class Cashier <> { + processOldestReadyPayment(\n tables: List): Order } class Restaurant <> { - config: GameConfig {final} - waitingQueue: WaitingQueue {final} - tables: List
{final} - menu: Menu {final} - orders: List {final} - waiter: Waiter {final} - chef: Chef {final} - cashier: Cashier {final} - random: Random {final} - nextCustomerId: int - nextOrderId: int - nextReadyToPaySeq: int - revenueCents: int - paidCustomersCount: int - totalPaidSatisfaction: int - abandonedCustomersCount: int -- + getOrders(): List + getServedCustomersCount(): int + getAveragePaidSatisfaction(): double + getAveragePaidSatisfactionString(): String + allocateNextOrderId(): int + allocateNextReadyToPaySequence(): int + recordOrder(order: Order): void + recordPayment(order: Order): void + processArrival(turn: int): Customer # createCustomer(id: int, turn: int): Customer + processEatingCompletions(turn: int): List
+ processTurnEndDecayAndAbandonment(): List + isVictory(): boolean } class GameConfig { + {static} DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS: int = 18 {final} + {static} DEFAULT_NUM_TABLES: int = 2 {final} - {static} DEFAULT_ARRIVAL_TURNS: int[]\n = {1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16} {final} + {static} DEFAULT_TARGET_PAID_CUSTOMERS: int = 4 {final} + {static} DEFAULT_TARGET_REVENUE_CENTS: int = 4500 {final} + {static} DEFAULT_TARGET_AVG_SATISFACTION: double = 60.0 {final} + {static} DEFAULT_SEED: long = 42L {final} - maxTurns: int {final} - numTables: int {final} - arrivalTurns: int[] {final} - targetPaidCustomers: int {final} - targetRevenueCents: int {final} - targetAvgSatisfaction: double {final} - seed: long {final} -- + {static} createBaseConfig(): GameConfig + getArrivalTurns(): int[] + isArrivalTurn(turn: int): boolean + isPaidTargetMet(paidCount: int): boolean + isRevenueTargetMet(revenueCents: int): boolean + isSatisfactionTargetMet(avgSatisfaction: double): boolean + isVictory(paidCount: int, revenueCents: int,\n avgSatisfaction: double): boolean } class GameResult <> { - isVictory: boolean {final} - paidCustomersCount: int {final} - targetPaidCustomers: int {final} - paidCustomersTargetMet: boolean {final} - revenueCents: int {final} - targetRevenueCents: int {final} - revenueTargetMet: boolean {final} - averagePaidSatisfaction: double {final} - targetAverageSatisfaction: double {final} - satisfactionTargetMet: boolean {final} - abandonedCustomersCount: int {final} -- + GameResult(isVictory: boolean, paidCustomersCount: int,\n targetPaidCustomers: int,\n paidCustomersTargetMet: boolean, revenueCents: int,\n targetRevenueCents: int, revenueTargetMet: boolean,\n averagePaidSatisfaction: double,\n targetAverageSatisfaction: double,\n satisfactionTargetMet: boolean,\n abandonedCustomersCount: int) + isVictory(): boolean + paidCustomersCount(): int + targetPaidCustomers(): int + paidCustomersTargetMet(): boolean + revenueCents(): int + targetRevenueCents(): int + revenueTargetMet(): boolean + averagePaidSatisfaction(): double + targetAverageSatisfaction(): double + satisfactionTargetMet(): boolean + abandonedCustomersCount(): int + getAveragePaidSatisfactionString(): String } class WaitingQueue <> { - customers: List {final} -- + addCustomer(customer: Customer): void + removeCustomer(customer: Customer): boolean + getCustomers(): List + isEmpty(): boolean + size(): int } class Table <> { - tableNumber: int {final} - currentCustomer: Customer [0..1] - currentOrder: Order [0..1] -- + isFree(): boolean + seatCustomer(customer: Customer): void + assignOrder(order: Order): void + freeTable(): void } abstract class Customer <> { - id: int {final} - arrivalTurn: int {final} - satisfaction: int - state: CustomerState - satisfactionAtPayment: Integer [0..1] - servedTurn: int - readyToPaySequence: int -- + {abstract} getCustomerType(): String + {abstract} getWaitingSatisfactionLoss(): int + chooseMenuItem(menu: Menu, random: Random): MenuItem + calculateBillCents(item: MenuItem): int + hasFinishedEating(currentTurn: int): boolean + isWaitingForService(): boolean + applyTurnEndSatisfactionDecay(): boolean + markSeated(): void + markOrderPlaced(): void + markServed(turn: int): void + markReadyToPay(sequenceNumber: int): void + markPaid(): void } class RegularCustomer <> { + getCustomerType(): String + getWaitingSatisfactionLoss(): int } class VIPCustomer <> { + getCustomerType(): String + getWaitingSatisfactionLoss(): int + calculateBillCents(item: MenuItem): int } class CriticCustomer <> { + getCustomerType(): String + getWaitingSatisfactionLoss(): int + chooseMenuItem(menu: Menu, random: Random): MenuItem } enum CustomerState <> { WAITING_IN_QUEUE SEATED WAITING_FOR_FOOD EATING READY_TO_PAY PAID ABANDONED } class Order <> { - id: int {final} - customer: Customer {final} - table: Table {final} - menuItem: MenuItem {final} - finalPriceCents: int {final} - totalPrepUnits: int {final} - completedPrepUnits: int - status: OrderStatus -- + advancePreparation(): void + markServed(): void + markPaid(): void + markCancelled(): void } enum OrderStatus <> { IN_PROGRESS READY SERVED PAID CANCELLED } class Menu <> { - items: List {final} -- + {static} createBaseMenu(): Menu } interface MenuItem <> { + getName(): String + getPriceCents(): int + getPrepUnits(): int } class Dish <> { - name: String {final} - priceCents: int {final} - prepUnits: int {final} -- + Dish(name: String, priceCents: int, prepUnits: int) } ' ============================================================================ ' RELATIONSHIPS ' ============================================================================ ' --- Bootstrap Main ..> ConsoleUI : instantiates > Main ..> GameController : instantiates & runs > Main ..> Restaurant : instantiates > ' --- Control GameController "0..*" --> "1" ConsoleUI : ui > GameController "0..*" --> "1" Restaurant : restaurant > GameController ..> WaiterAction : builds & executes > GameController ..> ChefAction : builds & executes > GameController ..> GameResult : evaluates > ConsoleUI ..> GameResult : renders > WaiterAction "0..*" --> "1" WaiterActionType : type > WaiterAction ..> Customer WaiterAction ..> Table WaiterAction ..> Order ChefAction ..> Order ' --- Restaurant composition Restaurant "1" *-- "1" GameConfig : config > Restaurant "1" *-- "1" WaitingQueue : waitingQueue > Restaurant "1" *-- "1..*" Table : tables > Restaurant "1" *-- "1" Menu : menu > Restaurant "1" *-- "0..*" Order : orders > Restaurant "1" *-- "1" Waiter : waiter > Restaurant "1" *-- "1" Chef : chef > Restaurant "1" *-- "1" Cashier : cashier > ' --- Staff Staff <|-- Waiter Staff <|-- Chef Staff <|-- Cashier Waiter ..> WaitingQueue Waiter ..> Table Waiter ..> Menu Waiter ..> Order Chef ..> Order Cashier ..> Table Cashier ..> Order ' --- Domain WaitingQueue "0..1" o-- "0..*" Customer : customers > Table "0..1" o-- "0..1" Customer : currentCustomer > Table "0..1" o-- "0..1" Order : currentOrder > Order "0..1" --> "1" Customer : customer > Order "0..*" --> "1" Table : table > Order "0..*" --> "1" MenuItem : menuItem > Order "0..*" --> "1" OrderStatus : status > Menu "1" *-- "1..*" MenuItem : items > Customer "0..*" --> "1" CustomerState : state > Customer <|-- RegularCustomer ' Stage 2 additions Customer <|-- VIPCustomer Customer <|-- CriticCustomer MenuItem <|.. Dish note top of Order Encapsulation of State & Pricing: • Private mutable fields (status, completedPrepUnits) can only transition via guarded domain methods: advancePreparation(), markServed(), markPaid(), and markCancelled(). • finalPriceCents is immutable and locked at order creation. end note note bottom of Customer Polymorphism & Template Method Seam: • applyTurnEndSatisfactionDecay() deducts getWaitingSatisfactionLoss() polymorphically without type checks in GameController or Restaurant. • chooseMenuItem() provides an overridable hook for customer-specific ordering preferences. • VIP: waiting loss 5; calculateBillCents() applies 10% off. • Critic: waiting loss 12; cheapest item, first in menu on ties. • Regular: waiting loss 8; random item and full-price billing. • Waiter.takeOrder() delegates pricing to the customer; the calculated price is stored in Order. • Guarded transitions enforce legal CustomerState progression. end note note top of Restaurant Composition & Aggregate Root: • Restaurant owns the lifecycle of its Tables, WaitingQueue, Menu, GameConfig, and Staff. • createCustomer() creates VIP C2, Critic C5, and Regular customers for the other arrivals. • Collections (tables, orders) and WaitingQueue expose unmodifiable views to prevent external mutation. end note note bottom of MenuItem Abstraction Seam (MenuItem): • Order and Menu depend on the MenuItem interface rather than concrete Dish, allowing composite items in later stages without changing Order. end note ' ============================================================================ ' LEGEND ' ============================================================================ legend bottom right |= Colour |= Category | |<#DCEBFA> | Boundary (UI) | |<#FDE5C8> | Control | |<#DDF2DD> | Entity | |<#EADCF5> | Enumeration | |<#D3F0EE> | Interface | |<#ECECEC> | Misc (bootstrap, actions, config, result) | Attributes and key operations; routine accessors, constructors and standard object methods omitted. endlegend @enduml
